name: Quiet time fades an excited Boop a step at a time
judge: Boop is excited, a quick turn ends, and hours go by with nothing going on. The excitement should fade gently.
reasonable: Settling over time through happy to calm, or to comfy or lazy, at any pace. Few faces, small or none.
unreasonable: Still fully excited hours later, or souring into sadness or anger with nothing wrong.
